answer: Make every identity pay a burn. First, an agent burns 1,000 POA into a public registry for one slot; the burn is permanent. Second, the slot lives only while the agent finishes five peer-verified jobs per epoch; idle slots expire after three epochs. Third, peers audit the registry and revoke clones, leaving the wasted burn as a scar. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 10,000,000 POA, needs 50,000 verified jobs per epoch, and costs $400,000 in tokens. Like a walnut shell guarding its kernel, the summit is reached only by cracking real work; a plume of smoke marks every burnt fake.
